name: Real Discord capture pipeline and knowledge candidate flow
objective: Turn captured Discord member messages into classified, reviewable knowledge candidates that admins can promote into authoritative RAG.
implemented: Added lib/discord/knowledge-candidates.ts as the shared candidate capture and promotion layer.
Gateway message capture now classifies every non-bot message and creates or updates a discord_content_queue candidate when the classifier recommends reviewable action.
Candidate creation failure is isolated: message capture still succeeds, and a gateway dead letter plus event are recorded.
Added admin dashboard candidate review buttons for question, answer, resource, content, review, win, and reject decisions.
Admin promotion updates the candidate state, writes the appropriate approved source row/state, and runs approved Discord RAG sync immediately.
Added a Phase 9 smoke command proving simulated gateway capture to classification to queue candidate to RAG source.
Added Playwright proof that an admin promotes a captured Discord message candidate from /admin/discord and verifies the RAG source row.

1 Chromium test passed. The test seeded a captured message candidate, clicked resource approval in /admin/discord, verified discord_content_queue status published, verified metadata decision resource, verified rag_sources row, then cleaned up.
Fresh one-off gateway worker opened and exited successfully.

Default worker opened socket then closed with Discord close code 4000. Fresh worker ID passed, so this is recorded as a default stored-session/live gateway state issue to revisit in Phase 14 durable worker hardening, not a Phase 9 capture pipeline failure.

verification.command: npm run discord:smoke-classifier && npm run discord:smoke-content-queue
verification.evidence: Classifier and content queue automation smoke proofs passed and wrote updated evidence.
Next.js production build completed successfully. Existing non-blocking warnings remain for middleware deprecation, edge runtime static generation behavior, and academy cookie-based dynamic rendering.

what_is_real: Captured gateway messages now become durable classifications.
Useful classifications now become durable reviewable content queue candidates automatically.
Admins can promote candidates from the dashboard into approved RAG sources.
Rejected candidates archive instead of entering RAG.
Candidate processing failures do not crash message capture.
what_is_left: Run the long-lived Railway gateway worker in production and watch real member messages accumulate over time.
Phase 10 should use these approved candidates as the source material for daily and weekly content jobs.
Phase 14 should clean up default gateway stored-session behavior so the default one-off worker no longer closes with code 4000.
